GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 1 length Settled Down Mid Field 3 Wide 2 lengths. Wide turn under pressure. weakened # 3 Wide trip
Jumped Ok sat half off 3 Wide No Cover , pushed along turn, joined in Straightening Up , joint lead 200m, headed approaching 100m, kept on fairly late # 3 Wide trip
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide and without cover throughout the event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 1 length Settled Down last 5 lengths. last turn looking for run. held up early in Straight . got to outside 200 metres. ran on very strongly to just miss # unlucky
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began only fairly. Was held up rounding the home turn and had difficulty obtaining completely clear running until passing the 200m. Lost its off-fore plate during the running.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok drifted back 6 lengths. got to outside in Straight .ran on well # Even Effort
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Underwent a pre-race vet exam after kicking a rail upon leaving the enclosure, and was cleared to start. Making the home turn became very awkwardly placed on heels before being directed inwards to continue into clear running. Approaching the 200m became momentarily awkwardly placed when being shifted outwards.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 1 length Settled Down Mid Field 4 lengths. got to outside in Straight . battled away # Even Effort
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: On jumping was badly hampered when crowded between rnrs. On straightening had difficulty obtaining clear running until passing the 300m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down on pace 3 wide. 3 Wide turn under pressure. dropped out # 3 Wide trip
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced three-wide and without cover throughout the event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 4 lengths. looking for run turn. got to outside 200 metres. just battled when clear # Every Chance
Slow Out 1/2 length Settled Down Mid Field 5 lengths. well back turn under pressure. ran on well # Even Effort
Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 3 lengths. got to outside turn 3 lengths. battled away # Every Chance
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Was a little slow to begin. Approaching the 800m after being ridden along after being slow to begin, the gelding was momentarily tightened by rnr which was taken in and eased from the heels of other rnr. Near 700m checked when crowded.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat 2-3l off, held together turn, Straightened Up 2 Lengths off, kept on one pace # held ground
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rider reported that although the gelding has somewhat established wet track form in his opinion failed to handle the Heavy 10 surface.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , scrubbed along 2nd Two Wide 2 Lengths 600m, No Match when Leader extended Straightening Up but he battled on well enough and held second spot # brave chase
Jumped Ok Settled Down 3rd 2 lengths. moved up 3 Wide turn 1 length. got to front 300 metres. weakened late # went early
